90% लोगों को दो वेबसाइट के बारे में शायद नहीं पता होगा। पहली वेबसाइट में आप किसी का भी नंबर डाल के ओनर की डिटेल, अल्टरनेटिव नंबर और उसकी एग्जैक्ट लोकेशन निकाल सकते हो। सेकंड वेबसाइट में आप किसी भी मूवीज को और वेब सीरीज को सेम डे पे वॉच कर सकते हो और उसको डाउनलोड भी कर सकते हो बिल्कुल हाई क्वालिटी में। अब इन दोनों वेबसाइट का लिंक पर्सनली आपके डीएम में शेयर कर दूंगा बस मुझे फॉलो करके रील तीन लोग के पास शेयर कर देना और कमेंट में वेबसाइट लिख देना। मुझे फॉलो जरूर कर लेना अदरवाइज ये लिंक आपको नहीं मिलेगा।

day five of using Claude as a real estate agent 🤖 today I’m showing you how I use my morning briefing Dashboard + giving you a free prompt to build your own here’s how: 1. open Cowork in the desktop app (not your browser) 2. go to customize connectors, and connect your google calendar, gmail, notion, your call recorder, anything you find in the directory. pro tip: if your CRM isn’t in the directory, go into your CRM’s settings and grab the API key — you can give that to Claude and it’ll connect. 3. then open a new task and give it a prompt. comment “morning” and I’ll send you a free prompt to use. 4. keep refining it after the first run — just tell Claude what you’d like it to fix and it will do it for you. comment ‘morning’ for the free prompt + a link to our waitlist for our next Claude training 👇👀 #claudeforrealtors #aiforrealtors
Day 5 of showing you how to use Claude. As a real estate agent, every morning Claude sends me everything I need to do for the day from my email, calendar, a sauna, and slack. It drafts replies for me and tells me what I should be delegating and pulls any context that I need to make decisions based on. That it time blocks my day for me, gives me a recap of yesterday's calls, and it even gives me a briefing for each of my calls for the day. And it's super easy to set up and customize, so let me show you how to do it. You need to be using Claude co work on the desktop app and you need to have the 20 dollar a month version. First connect your tools by going to customize connectors and then adding your connectors. So your Asana calendar Gmail. You can create this by going to scheduled then clicking New Task create with Claude and then prompt it with exactly what you want it to show up on your dashboard. Comment morning below and I'll send you a free prompt that you can use and a link to join our waitlist for our next Claude training.
